plan.h: Rough cut 6: the reel, made real
items: Your six round-11 picks replace all eight Flow stills. There's no AI left in the reel. The other real footage (Lahaina, the flood, the tornado, the data centres) stays.
The six, in reel order: the camera pole, the hobby drone, the war drone over the smoking range, the London robotaxi stopped by the lollipop man, the tip screen, the delivery robot at the crossing.
The war drone is a frame from 8 s. The trench shot you picked from the preview has the Army's 'Increased Lethality' caption burned in under it the whole time, so I used the moment before.
The robotaxi is cropped to the car's nose and the lollipop man; the delivery robot is cropped to leave the man out.
The reel is 20 shots (was 22), so everything after it comes about a second earlier. 37.05 s in all.

plan.h: What changed to pass the flashing check
items: The order is still bright to dark, but set so nearly every cut goes darker. The straight sort failed (5 flashes a second at 15 s).
The zoom on the reel's still pictures is gentler (4% instead of 10%): the bigger zoom counted as extra flashes. Now 2 a second, safer than rough cut 5's 3.
Any shot to swap or drop? The other round-11 options are still on the picks page.

Before the final export: the three Commons pictures come from Wikimedia's preview server (the full-size originals were blocked for too many requests). They look fine at phone size; I'll fetch the originals once it lets us.
